server.name: elesium-sovereign-ai-mcp
server.description: Model Context Protocol server for enterprise autonomous agents. Provides tools to audit AI architectures, verify sub-200ms latency, calculate private cloud TCO arbitrage, and schedule 14-day production sprints.

tools.name: audit_enterprise_architecture
tools.description: Evaluates an enterprise workflow for state graph determinism, infinite loop vulnerability, and statutory compliance.

architecture_type.description: Current agentic topology deployed in production

current_latency_ms.description: Observed end-to-end execution latency in milliseconds

compliance_jurisdiction.description: Primary regulatory statutory standard governing data processing

tools.name: calculate_tco_arbitrage
tools.description: Calculates 3-year total cost of ownership (TCO) comparing dedicated private H100 vLLM serving against public API tokens.

monthly_token_volume_millions.description: Estimated monthly input + output token volume in millions

public_model_baseline.description: Baseline public cloud API model currently utilized

tools.name: verify_statutory_compliance
tools.description: Audits enterprise data residency and generates a statutory risk profile under DPDP Act 2023, HIPAA, and SEC Rule 17a-4.

data_residency_model.description: Where model weights and prompt logs are physically processed

tools.name: request_pilot_sprint
tools.description: Initiates an automated enterprise pilot intake sprint with a 14-day production delivery SLA and contractual 90-day ROI guarantee.

enterprise_name.description: Legal name of the enterprise client

contact_email.description: Official corporate email of the technical sponsor
